about_the_game:
Your dream of owning a farm falls apart the moment you arrive in the village. The land has already been claimed, and the only job left is collecting the town’s garbage. With nothing but determination, you begin piecing together a new life from what others throw away.

Bitter Harvest is a 2D farming simulation about ambition, reinvention, and quiet revenge. Earn money through crafting, farming, and odd jobs as you climb from the bottom of the social ladder. Build relationships with the townsfolk, uncover their secrets, and decide how far you’re willing to go to take back what was stolen.

Every choice leaves a mark, and there’s a twist waiting at the end that shows what kind of person you’ve really become.

Features

  • Rags-to-riches story: Rise from trash collector to landowner through work, wit, or manipulation.

  • Farming: Grow and sell crops to earn income and expand your land.

  • Crafting: Turn salvaged materials into tools, goods, and upgrades.

  • Fishing: Spend quiet days by the water or reel in catches to sell at the market.

  • Mining: Dig for ore and rare finds to fuel your rise in the village economy.

  • Cooking: Create meals that boost your energy, charm, or profits.

  • Personal relationships: Each villager reacts to your choices, ambitions, and reputation.

  • Scandals and secrets: Learn what others hide and decide whether to use it for profit or let it be.

  • A cozy world with sharp undertones: Peaceful days and simple labor hide a story about power and consequence.

Beneath the soft fields and quiet nights, the village keeps its score. Work hard, play smart, and maybe you’ll finally get what’s yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (32-bit or 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Cast out of your rightful farm, you’ll scrape, scheme, and rebuild your way to power in this gorgeous, 2D farming sim about ambition and payback.
